card.essence: A profound remedy for nutritive derangement with emaciation (especially neck), anæmia, and marked dryness of mucous membranes. The mental picture centres on deep, silent grief aggravated by consolation, coupled with irritability and a desire to be alone. Physical symptoms follow periodicity (10–11 a.m.), with throbbing headaches, palpitation, and craving for salt. The patient appears greasy, sallow, and prostrated.

keynotes.text: Great emaciation, especially of neck, despite eating well
Throbbing headache as if a thousand hammers, sunrise to sunset
Tears stream down face on coughing
Mapped tongue with red insular patches
Craving for salt; aversion to bread and fats
Dry, crumbling stool; anus contracted, torn, bleeding
Periodicity at 10–11 a.m. (headache, fever, malarial paroxysms)
Palpitation shakes whole body; worse lying down or on left side

modalities_worse.text: Heat of sun or summer; seashore air
Lying down, especially on left side

modalities_better.text: Going without regular meals; before breakfast

mentals: Depressed, particularly in chronic disease; weeps alone, aggravated by consolation
Irritable, gets into a passion about trifles; awkward, hasty
Desires to be alone to cry; tears with laughter; hysterical alternations
Ill effects of grief, fright, anger, unrequited affection
Forgetful; cannot concentrate; loses thread of reading or conversation
Dreams of robbers in the house, searches on waking
Hypochondria; joyless even with cheering circumstances
physicals: Anæmia and chlorosis with debility worst in morning in bed
Dryness of mucous membranes (lips, mouth, throat, rectum, vagina)
Lips and corners of mouth dry, ulcerated, cracked; deep crack middle lower lip
Herpes and vesicles like pearls about lips, at edge of hair, around anus
Hay fever with squirming sensation as of small worm in nostril; from hot sun
Violent fluent coryza with thin, watery discharge like raw egg white; violent sneezing
Eyes give out on reading or writing; letters run together; lachrymation acrid
Constipation with anus contracted, torn, bleeding; stitches in rectum
Urine involuntary when walking, coughing, laughing; must wait if others present
Menses irregular, usually profuse; vagina dry; bearing-down worse morning
Cough from tickling in pit of stomach with spurting of urine
Heart fluttering, palpitation shakes body; intermits lying down
Hangnails; skin around nails dry, cracked
Warts on palms of hands, sore to touch
Eczema raw, red, inflamed at edges of hair; worse too much salt, seashore
Urticaria over whole body after violent exercise
clinical: Intermittent fever: paroxysm 10–11 a.m., old chronic cases after quinine suppression
Anæmic headache of schoolgirls; discouraged, nervous, broken down
Stricture of lachrymal duct with suppuration
Prolapsus uteri with cutting in urethra; bearing-down worse morning
Chronic headache semi-lateral, congestive, sunrise to sunset, from eyestrain or menses
Asthenopia due to insufficiency of internal recti muscles
Summer complaint with rapid emaciation of throat and neck in children

differentials.note: Ignatia is the acute vegetable analogue; Natrum mur. is its chronic. If Ignatia only temporarily benefits without deep cure, give Natrum mur.
Both have bearing-down worse morning, prolapsus. Sepia follows Natrum mur. well. Natrum mur. more emaciation of neck, craves salt, grief aggravated by consolation.
Both weep easily, but Pulsatilla is soothed and comforted by consolation, while Natrum mur. is aggravated. Pulsatilla warm-blooded, thirstless; Natrum chilly, great thirst.
Both have palpitation shaking body. Phosphorus craves cold drinks, ice, sympathetic; Natrum mur. craves salt, averse to consolation.
Both cure headaches of schoolgirls in anæmic states. Calcarea phos. more suited to delayed dentition, open fontanelles, growing pains.

cautions: Should never be given during fever paroxysm (give intercurrently)
Cannot often be repeated in chronic cases without an intercurrent remedy
If vertigo and headache persist or prostration prolonged after Natrum, use Nux vomica
Aggravation from abuse of silver nitrate (cauterization); antidote with Natrum mur.
